Solid Threads Men's Cotton Joggers, 220 GSM, Slim Fit, Grey, Size M
- 220 GSM brushed cotton: heavier than most joggers at this price, so the knees don't bag after a wash
- Two side pockets 16 cm deep, deep enough for a phone that won't fall out when you sit
- Real drawstring cord and a 4 cm elastic waistband that holds its stretch after 30 washes in our tests
- Runs slightly long: if you're between sizes, pick the smaller one
- Made in Tiruppur, India. Machine wash cold, dry in shade
